name: twinline
description: Bilingual mode for Claude Code: write in your language, let Claude work in English, read both side by side.

default_enabled.title: Enabled by default
default_enabled.description: Start every new session with Twinline on. Default: true.

language.title: Your language (default zh-CN)
language.description: BCP-47 code of the language you write and read in, e.g. zh-CN, ja, de. Default: zh-CN (used when left blank).

translate_input.title: Translate input
translate_input.description: Translate what you type into English before it is sent. Default: true.

translate_output.title: Translate output
translate_output.description: Show a translation under each of Claude's replies. Default: true.

model.title: Translation model (default haiku)
model.description: Model alias or id used for translation through your Claude Code sign-in. Default: haiku (used when left blank).

glossary.title: Glossary
glossary.description: One term per entry as source=target, e.g. 工作区=workspace. Default: none.

always_translate_input.title: Always translate input
always_translate_input.description: Also translate input that contains only ASCII letters (needed for languages written in Latin script). Default: false.

show_band_when_off.title: Show band when off
show_band_when_off.description: Keep the Twinline band above the prompt while it is off. Default: true.

input_timeout_ms.title: Input timeout, ms (default 8000)
input_timeout_ms.description: Give up translating a prompt after this long and send it as typed. Default: 8000 (used when left blank).

settle_ms.title: Reply settle time, ms (default 1200)
settle_ms.description: How long a reply block must stay unchanged before it is translated. Default: 1200 (used when left blank).

backend.title: Backend
backend.description: Where translations are computed. Default: claude (your Claude Code sign-in; nothing leaves Claude).

backend_url.title: Backend URL
backend_url.description: Base URL for openai/ollama (e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1) or DeepL API host. Leave blank for the backend's standard URL.

backend_model.title: Backend model
backend_model.description: Model name for openai/ollama backends. Only needed for those backends.

backend_key.title: Backend API key
backend_key.description: API key for the external backend. Stored in secure storage. Only needed for openai/deepl.
